timestamp.description: The time stamp used for the data point.

sum.description: The sum of the metric values for the data point.

avg.description: The average of the metric values that correspond to the data point.

max.description: The maximum metric value for the data point.

min.description: The minimum metric value for the data point.

count.description: The number of metric values that contributed to the aggregate value of this data point.

unit.description: The standard unit for the data point.

title: DataPoint encapsulates the statistical data that Amazon CloudWatch computes from metric data.
name: AwsCloudWatchDataPoint
